description: Single Serve Sugar Cookie 🤍 Recipe: * 2 tbsp unsalted butter, softened/melted to touch * 3 1/2 tbsp white granulated sugar * 1 egg yolk * 1/2 tsp vanilla extract * 1/3 cup all purpose flour * 1/2 tsp baking powder * 1/4 tsp salt Sugar for sprinkling. 🤍 Bake Temperature: 350F Bake Time: 14-15 minutes 1. Preheat oven to 350F. 2. In a bowl, place your butter and sugar. Cream together for 1 minute. 3. Add your egg yolk and vanilla extract and whisk in. 4. Now add your dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, salt. 5. Fully incorporate those ingredients together. 6. Cover and place in freezer for 5 minutes. 7. Take out of freezer and form your cookie dough into one big cookie. 8. Drench cookie in sugar. 9. Place on a baking sheet and bake on 350F for 14-15 minutes. 10. Take out of oven and sprinkle more sugar on top. 11. Enjoy 🤍 #sugarcookie #sugarcookies #singleservecookie #cookierecipe #desserttiktok #introvertsweets
